changes.comment: Add formatValueForMessage, which renders any value for a failure or diagnostic message without throwing. It calls JSON.stringify with a replacer that only turns an active-path cycle into "[Circular]" and a BigInt into "123n", so every value JSON.stringify rendered without throwing renders byte-identically up to the length bound (200). Where JSON.stringify still throws (a throwing getter, Proxy trap or toJSON), a fallback renders [Unreadable] for what it cannot read; a top-level undefined, symbol or function renders as a readable token. Every converter and validator failure message now uses it, so failure text changes only for inputs that previously threw and for values over the length bound, which are truncated with an ellipsis. BaseConverter and GenericValidator turn a throw from the function they wrap into a Failure reading 'converter threw: <message>' or 'validator threw: <message>', so convert, validate and guard never throw (personaility#714); stack exhaustion in nested converters is re-thrown to the outermost one and fails once there. stringifyLogValue no longer throws for a value with no string conversion, or whose toJSON yields nothing.
